info.brief: Functions and constants for Unity LevelPlay mediation on Android and iOS.
info.description: Functions and constants for Unity LevelPlay mediation on Android and iOS.

elements.name: levelplay.set_callback
elements.description: Sets the callback used for all LevelPlay events. Pass nil to remove it.

elements.name: levelplay.init
elements.description: Initializes LevelPlay. Configure privacy before calling this function. Create ad objects only after EVENT_INIT_SUCCEEDED.

parameters.name: app_key
parameters.doc: Application key from the LevelPlay dashboard. This is not an ad-unit ID.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.doc: Stable application user ID included in the initialization request.

elements.name: levelplay.get_sdk_version
elements.description: Returns the native LevelPlay SDK version.

elements.name: levelplay.set_gdpr_consent
elements.description: Passes the user's GDPR consent choice to LevelPlay and supported mediated networks. It does not display a consent form or read another extension's private state. For a custom or non-compatible CMP, call it before init with the collected choice. LevelPlay SDK 7.7.0 and newer automatically reads Google UMP and compatible Google Additional Consent signals, so do not also pass the same choice with this function in that setup.

elements.name: levelplay.set_ccpa
elements.description: Passes a US privacy "do not sell or share" choice. True means the user opted out. Call before init.

elements.name: levelplay.set_coppa
elements.description: Sets whether the user is child-directed for COPPA treatment. True flags the user as child-directed. Call before init.

elements.name: levelplay.set_metadata
elements.description: Sets an SDK or mediated-network metadata value. Set network-required values before init.

elements.name: levelplay.set_meta_limited_data_use
elements.description: Configures Meta Audience Network Limited Data Use before init. This calls Meta's SDK directly and returns false if the Meta adapter is not linked or initialization already started.

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.doc: True supplies the LDU option; false clears Meta data-processing options.

parameters.name: country
parameters.doc: Meta country code. Zero, the default, asks Meta to geolocate.

parameters.name: state
parameters.doc: Meta state code. Zero, the default, asks Meta to geolocate.

elements.name: levelplay.set_meta_advertiser_tracking
elements.description: Sets Meta Audience Network's iOS advertiser-tracking flag before init. Returns false on Android, when Meta is not linked, or after initialization starts.

elements.name: levelplay.set_dynamic_user_id
elements.description: Sets the dynamic user ID used by server-to-server rewarded callbacks. The value must contain 1–64 alphanumeric characters. Call before showing the rewarded ad it should apply to.

elements.name: levelplay.set_adapters_debug
elements.description: Enables or disables mediated-network debug logging. Disable it in production.

elements.name: levelplay.validate_integration
elements.description: Runs the native LevelPlay integration validator.

elements.name: levelplay.launch_test_suite
elements.description: Opens the LevelPlay integration test suite after initialization succeeds. Enable the is_test_suite metadata before init and call this before creating ad objects or invoking other LevelPlay SDK operations.

elements.name: levelplay.request_tracking_authorization
elements.description: Requests App Tracking Transparency authorization on iOS 14 or newer. Request it before init when mediation partners should receive the IDFA. The result is sent through MSG_TRACKING. It is a no-op on Android and unsupported iOS versions.

elements.name: levelplay.get_tracking_authorization_status
elements.description: Returns the current App Tracking Transparency state on iOS, or nil when unsupported.

returnvalues.name: status
returnvalues.doc: One of TRACKING_STATUS_NOT_DETERMINED, TRACKING_STATUS_RESTRICTED, TRACKING_STATUS_DENIED, or TRACKING_STATUS_AUTHORIZED.

elements.name: levelplay.create_interstitial_ad
elements.description: Creates a reusable interstitial ad object after successful initialization. Its ad-unit ID and optional bid floor are fixed for the object's lifetime. Create it once, then use the returned handle for multiple load/show cycles with the same ad-unit ID and creation configuration.

parameters.name: ad_unit_id
parameters.doc: Interstitial ad-unit ID from the LevelPlay dashboard.

parameters.name: bid_floor
parameters.doc: Optional minimum eCPM in USD. It applies to every load by this object; changing it requires destroying the handle and creating a new object.

returnvalues.name: handle
returnvalues.doc: Positive handle, or nil when native creation is rejected.

elements.name: levelplay.destroy_interstitial_ad
elements.description: Permanently releases an interstitial ad object, invalidates its handle, and stops callbacks for it. Do not destroy between ordinary impressions or during load/display when terminal callbacks are still required.

elements.name: levelplay.load_interstitial_ad
elements.description: Loads the next interstitial impression into an existing object. After an impression closes, call this again on the same handle instead of creating another object.

elements.name: levelplay.is_interstitial_ad_ready
elements.description: Returns whether the interstitial object has an ad ready to display.

elements.name: levelplay.show_interstitial_ad
elements.description: Shows one loaded interstitial impression. The optional placement is a dashboard presentation point, not an ad object, and can be selected separately on every show.

elements.name: levelplay.is_interstitial_placement_capped
elements.description: Returns whether the named interstitial placement has reached its configured cap.

elements.name: levelplay.create_rewarded_ad
elements.description: Creates a reusable rewarded ad object after successful initialization. Its ad-unit ID and optional bid floor are fixed for the object's lifetime. Create it once, then use the returned handle for multiple load/show cycles with the same ad-unit ID and creation configuration.

parameters.name: ad_unit_id
parameters.doc: Rewarded ad-unit ID from the LevelPlay dashboard.

parameters.name: bid_floor
parameters.doc: Optional minimum eCPM in USD. It applies to every load by this object; changing it requires destroying the handle and creating a new object.

returnvalues.name: handle
returnvalues.doc: Positive handle, or nil when native creation is rejected.

elements.name: levelplay.destroy_rewarded_ad
elements.description: Permanently releases a rewarded ad object, invalidates its handle, and stops callbacks for it. Do not destroy between ordinary impressions, and never destroy a displayed rewarded ad before its reward and close callbacks are received.

elements.name: levelplay.load_rewarded_ad
elements.description: Loads the next rewarded impression into an existing object. After reward and close callbacks complete, call this again on the same handle instead of creating another object.

elements.name: levelplay.is_rewarded_ad_ready
elements.description: Returns whether the rewarded object has an ad ready to display.

elements.name: levelplay.show_rewarded_ad
elements.description: Shows one loaded rewarded impression. The optional placement is a dashboard presentation point, not an ad object, and can be selected separately on every show.

elements.name: levelplay.is_rewarded_placement_capped
elements.description: Returns whether the named rewarded placement has reached its configured cap.

elements.name: levelplay.get_reward
elements.description: Returns the configured reward for the object's default placement or for the supplied placement.

elements.name: levelplay.create_banner_ad
elements.description: Creates a reusable banner ad view after successful initialization. Its ad-unit ID and all options are fixed for the view's lifetime. Create it once, then load, hide, show, and auto-refresh the same handle until it is permanently destroyed.

parameters.name: ad_unit_id
parameters.doc: Banner ad-unit ID from the LevelPlay dashboard.

parameters.name: options
parameters.doc: Creation-time banner configuration. These fields apply to every load and show; changing one requires destroying the handle and creating a new banner.

returnvalues.name: handle
returnvalues.doc: Positive handle, or nil when native creation is rejected.

elements.name: levelplay.load_banner_ad
elements.description: Loads and displays a banner because the native LevelPlay banner view is visible by default.

elements.name: levelplay.show_banner_ad
elements.description: Makes the banner view visible.

elements.name: levelplay.hide_banner_ad
elements.description: Hides the banner without destroying it.

elements.name: levelplay.pause_banner_auto_refresh
elements.description: Pauses automatic refresh for the banner.

elements.name: levelplay.resume_banner_auto_refresh
elements.description: Resumes automatic refresh for the banner.

elements.name: levelplay.destroy_banner_ad
elements.description: Removes and destroys the banner view and invalidates its handle.

elements.name: levelplay.MSG_INIT
elements.description: Initialization events.

elements.name: levelplay.MSG_INTERSTITIAL
elements.description: Interstitial-object events.

elements.name: levelplay.MSG_REWARDED
elements.description: Rewarded-object events.

elements.name: levelplay.MSG_BANNER
elements.description: Banner-object events.

elements.name: levelplay.MSG_TRACKING
elements.description: App Tracking Transparency status events.
